ops.old: Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion, chipotle crema and fresh coriander. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp chipotle sauce. Fill 12 warm tortillas with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.
